repeaters.label: Occasion Options
repeaters.notice:
Each option’s Value is what the form submits. Edit labels freely; change a value only if whatever receives it expects the new one.

These values must match the HubSpot property trip_occasion exactly. It is a required dropdown on the Private & Tailormade Inquiry form, so a value HubSpot does not list gets the whole enquiry rejected. Change both together.
